1. import { ContractReceipt } from 'ethers';
2. import {
3.   type ExecuteSwapParams,
4.   executeSwapParamsSchema,
5.   type NativeSwapParams,
6.   type TokenSwapParams,
7.   NativeCallParams,
8.   TokenCallParams,
9. } from './schemas';
10. import { Vault__factory } from '../abis';
11. import {
12.   checkAllowance,
13.   extractOverrides,
14.   getTokenContractAddress,
15.   getVaultManagerContractAddress,
16.   TransactionOptions,
17. } from '../contracts';
18. import { assetContractIds, chainContractIds } from '../enums';
19. import { assert, isTokenCall, isTokenSwap } from '../guards';
20. import { SwapNetworkOptions } from './index';
21. 
22. const swapNative = async (
23.   { destChain, destAsset, destAddress, amount }: NativeSwapParams,
24.   networkOpts: SwapNetworkOptions,
25.   txOpts: TransactionOptions,
26. ): Promise<ContractReceipt> => {
27.   const vaultContractAddress =
28.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
29.       ? networkOpts.vaultContractAddress
30.       : getVaultManagerContractAddress(networkOpts.network);
31. 
32.   const vault = Vault__factory.connect(
33.     vaultContractAddress,
34.     networkOpts.signer,
35.   );
36. 
37.   const transaction = await vault.xSwapNative(
38.     chainContractIds[destChain],
39.     destAddress,
40.     assetContractIds[destAsset],
41.     [],
42.     { value: amount, ...extractOverrides(txOpts) },
43.   );
44. 
45.   return transaction.wait(txOpts.wait);
46. };
47. 
48. const swapToken = async (
49.   params: TokenSwapParams,
50.   networkOpts: SwapNetworkOptions,
51.   txOpts: TransactionOptions,
52. ): Promise<ContractReceipt> => {
53.   const vaultContractAddress =
54.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
55.       ? networkOpts.vaultContractAddress
56.       : getVaultManagerContractAddress(networkOpts.network);
57. 
58.   const erc20Address =
59.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
60.       ? networkOpts.srcTokenContractAddress
61.       : getTokenContractAddress(params.srcAsset, networkOpts.network);
62. 
63.   assert(erc20Address !== undefined, 'Missing ERC20 contract address');
64. 
65.   const { isAllowable } = await checkAllowance(
66.     params.amount,
67.     vaultContractAddress,
68.     erc20Address,
69.     networkOpts.signer,
70.   );
71.   assert(isAllowable, 'Swap amount exceeds allowance');
72. 
73.   const vault = Vault__factory.connect(
74.     vaultContractAddress,
75.     networkOpts.signer,
76.   );
77. 
78.   const transaction = await vault.xSwapToken(
79.     chainContractIds[params.destChain],
80.     params.destAddress,
81.     assetContractIds[params.destAsset],
82.     erc20Address,
83.     params.amount,
84.     [],
85.     extractOverrides(txOpts),
86.   );
87. 
88.   return transaction.wait(txOpts.wait);
89. };
90. 
91. const callNative = async (
92.   params: NativeCallParams,
93.   networkOpts: SwapNetworkOptions,
94.   txOpts: TransactionOptions,
95. ): Promise<ContractReceipt> => {
96.   const vaultContractAddress =
97.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
98.       ? networkOpts.vaultContractAddress
99.       : getVaultManagerContractAddress(networkOpts.network);
100. 
101.   const vault = Vault__factory.connect(
102.     vaultContractAddress,
103.     networkOpts.signer,
104.   );
105. 
106.   const transaction = await vault.xCallNative(
107.     chainContractIds[params.destChain],
108.     params.destAddress,
109.     assetContractIds[params.destAsset],
110.     params.ccmMetadata.message,
111.     params.ccmMetadata.gasBudget,
112.     [],
113.     { value: params.amount, ...extractOverrides(txOpts) },
114.   );
115. 
116.   return transaction.wait(txOpts.wait);
117. };
118. 
119. const callToken = async (
120.   params: TokenCallParams,
121.   networkOpts: SwapNetworkOptions,
122.   txOpts: TransactionOptions,
123. ): Promise<ContractReceipt> => {
124.   const vaultContractAddress =
125.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
126.       ? networkOpts.vaultContractAddress
127.       : getVaultManagerContractAddress(networkOpts.network);
128. 
129.   const erc20Address =
130.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
131.       ? networkOpts.srcTokenContractAddress
132.       : getTokenContractAddress(params.srcAsset, networkOpts.network);
133. 
134.   assert(erc20Address !== undefined, 'Missing ERC20 contract address');
135. 
136.   const { isAllowable } = await checkAllowance(
137.     params.amount,
138.     vaultContractAddress,
139.     erc20Address,
140.     networkOpts.signer,
141.   );
142.   assert(isAllowable, 'Swap amount exceeds allowance');
143. 
144.   const vault = Vault__factory.connect(
145.     vaultContractAddress,
146.     networkOpts.signer,
147.   );
148. 
149.   const transaction = await vault.xCallToken(
150.     chainContractIds[params.destChain],
151.     params.destAddress,
152.     assetContractIds[params.destAsset],
153.     params.ccmMetadata.message,
154.     params.ccmMetadata.gasBudget,
155.     erc20Address,
156.     params.amount,
157.     [],
158.     extractOverrides(txOpts),
159.   );
160. 
161.   return transaction.wait(txOpts.wait);
162. };
163. 
164. const executeSwap = async (
165.   params: ExecuteSwapParams,
166.   networkOpts: SwapNetworkOptions,
167.   txOpts: TransactionOptions,
168. ): Promise<ContractReceipt> => {
169.   const parsedParams = executeSwapParamsSchema.parse(params);
170. 
171.   if ('ccmMetadata' in parsedParams) {
172.     return isTokenCall(parsedParams)
173.       ? callToken(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts)
174.       : callNative(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts);
175.   }
176. 
177.   return isTokenSwap(parsedParams)
178.     ? swapToken(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts)
179.     : swapNative(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts);
180. };
181. 
182. export default executeSwap;
183.

120. const callToken = async (
121.   params: TokenCallParams,
122.   networkOpts: SwapNetworkOptions,
123.   txOpts: TransactionOptions,
124. ): Promise<TransactionReceipt> => {
125.   const vaultContractAddress =
126.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
127.       ? networkOpts.vaultContractAddress
128.       : getVaultManagerContractAddress(networkOpts.network);
129. 
130.   const erc20Address =
131.     networkOpts.network === 'localnet'
132.       ? networkOpts.srcTokenContractAddress
133.       : getTokenContractAddress(params.srcAsset, networkOpts.network);
134. 
135.   assert(erc20Address !== undefined, 'Missing ERC20 contract address');
136. 
137.   const { isAllowable } = await checkAllowance(
138.     params.amount,
139.     vaultContractAddress,
140.     erc20Address,
141.     networkOpts.signer,
142.   );
143.   assert(isAllowable, 'Swap amount exceeds allowance');
144. 
145.   const vault = Vault__factory.connect(
146.     vaultContractAddress,
147.     networkOpts.signer,
148.   );
149. 
150.   const transaction = await vault.xCallToken(
151.     chainContractIds[params.destChain],
152.     params.destAddress,
153.     assetContractIds[params.destAsset],
154.     params.ccmMetadata.message,
155.     params.ccmMetadata.gasBudget,
156.     erc20Address,
157.     params.amount,
158.     [],
159.     extractOverrides(txOpts),
160.   );
161. 
162.   return waitForReceipt(transaction, txOpts.wait);
163. };

165. const executeSwap = async (
166.   params: ExecuteSwapParams,
167.   networkOpts: SwapNetworkOptions,
168.   txOpts: TransactionOptions,
169. ): Promise<TransactionReceipt> => {
170.   const parsedParams = executeSwapParamsSchema.parse(params);
171. 
172.   if ('ccmMetadata' in parsedParams) {
173.     return isTokenCall(parsedParams)
174.       ? callToken(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts)
175.       : callNative(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts);
176.   }
177. 
178.   return isTokenSwap(parsedParams)
179.     ? swapToken(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts)
180.     : swapNative(parsedParams, networkOpts, txOpts);
181. };

data.content:
Implemented ethers 6.7.1 compatibility without modifying test files.

Updated source to use ethers v6 APIs, regenerated TypeChain bindings for `ethers-v6`, added a small v5-compat shim for existing `BigNumber`/`providers` consumers, and bumped workspace `ethers` dependencies plus the TypeChain plugin.

Validated with:
- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm eslint:check`
- `pnpm prettier:check`
- `pnpm --filter sdk-shared test:ci`
- `pnpm --filter sdk test:ci`
- `pnpm --filter cli test:ci`
- `pnpm syncpack:list`

The full `pnpm -r test:ci` still cannot complete because the swap package global setup fails before tests with Prisma `P1013` due to an invalid database URL in the environment.
